class.name: GDTelemetrySnapshot
class.brief_description: Container for a single telemetry data snapshot from Assetto Corsa.
class.description:
[GDTelemetrySnapshot] represents a moment in time during a racing session, containing detailed physics and graphics data captured at a specific timestamp.
Each snapshot includes vehicle dynamics (acceleration, speed, steering), tire information (wear, temperature, slip), and session state (lap times, position, flags).

member.name: snapshot_timestamp
member.description: The time offset from the start of the lap (in seconds).

member.name: physics_packetId
member.description: Unique identifier for this physics data packet.

member.name: physics_gas
member.description: Throttle input normalized to 0.0-1.0 range.

member.name: physics_brake
member.description: Brake input normalized to 0.0-1.0 range.

member.name: physics_fuel
member.description: Current fuel level in liters.

member.name: physics_gear
member.description: Current gear (0 for reverse, 1 for neutral, 2 and above for forward gears).

member.name: physics_rpms
member.description: Engine RPM.

member.name: physics_steerAngle
member.description: Steering wheel angle in radians (positive is right turn).

member.name: physics_speedKmh
member.description: Vehicle speed in kilometers per hour.

member.name: physics_velocity
member.description: Velocity vector components in m/s (world related).

member.name: physics_accG
member.description: G-force vector components (local related)

member.name: physics_wheelSlip
member.description: Spin speed of each tyre (FL, FR, RL, RR).

member.name: physics_wheelLoad
member.description: Vertical load on each wheel in Newtons (FL, FR, RL, RR).

member.name: physics_wheelsPressure
member.description: Tire pressure for each wheel in PSI (FL, FR, RL, RR).

member.name: physics_wheelAngularSpeed
member.description: Angular speed of each wheel in rad/s (FL, FR, RL, RR).

member.name: physics_tyreWear
member.description: Tire wear for each wheel, ranging from 0.0 (fully worn) to 100.0 (new) (FL, FR, RL, RR).

member.name: physics_tyreDirtyLevel
member.description: Dirt level on each tire from 0.0 to 1.0 (FL, FR, RL, RR).

member.name: physics_tyreCoreTemperature
member.description: Core temperature of each tire in Celsius (FL, FR, RL, RR).

member.name: physics_camberRAD
member.description: Camber angle for each wheel in radians (FL, FR, RL, RR).

member.name: physics_suspensionTravel
member.description: Suspension compression distance for each wheel in meters (FL, FR, RL, RR).

member.name: physics_drs
member.description: DRS state: 0 (closed) or 1 (open). Only valid if DRS is available on the car.

member.name: physics_tc
member.description: Slip ratio limit for the traction control (if enabled).

member.name: physics_heading
member.description: Vehicle heading angle in radians.

member.name: physics_pitch
member.description: Vehicle pitch angle in radians (nose-down is positive).

member.name: physics_roll
member.description: Vehicle roll angle in radians (right roll is positive).

member.name: physics_cgHeight
member.description: Height of the vehicle center of gravity in meters.

member.name: physics_carDamage
member.description: Damage level for each corner of the chassis from 0.0 to 1.0 (FL, FR, RL, RR).

member.name: physics_numberOfTyresOut

member.name: physics_pitLimiterOn

member.name: physics_abs
member.description: Slip ratio limit for the ABS (if enabled).

member.name: physics_kersCharge

member.name: physics_kersInput
member.description: KERS/ERS deployment input level from 0.0 to 1.0.

member.name: physics_autoShifterOn
member.description: Whether automatic gear shifting is engaged (1 = active, 0 = inactive).

member.name: physics_rideHeight
member.description: Ride height from ground for front (x) and rear (y) axles in meters.

member.name: physics_turboBoost
member.description: Turbocharger boost pressure in bars.

member.name: physics_ballast

member.name: physics_airDensity
member.description: Air density affecting aerodynamic forces.

member.name: physics_airTemp

member.name: physics_roadTemp
member.description: Track surface temperature in Celsius.

member.name: physics_localAngularVel
member.description: Vehicle angular velocity in local coordinates (rad/s).

member.name: physics_finalFF
member.description: Final force feedback value for steering wheel.

member.name: physics_performanceMeter
member.description: Performance meter compared to the best lap.

member.name: physics_engineBrake

member.name: physics_ersRecoveryLevel

member.name: physics_ersHeatCharging

member.name: physics_kersCurrentKJ

member.description: Clutch input normalized to 0.0-1.0 range.

member.name: physics_tyreContactHeading

member.name: physics_brakeBias

member.name: physics_localVelocity
